title: Finite Q3 split-history to exact-Hamiltonian Lie-Trotter convergence carrier
question: For the declared finite Q3 Hamiltonians, do both onsite-plus-bond Lie-Trotter orders and both time signs converge to the same exact full-Hamiltonian unitary at a fixed horizon, and does the associated two-orientation Volterra history converge with them?
method: Reuse the hash-pinned oscillator-dimension-three edge, square and 2x3 Q3 fixture from EXP-001160, with source pair [0,1], one probe site per volume, beta values 0.5, 1 and 2, and volumes 2, 4 and 6.

Reconstruct the full Hamiltonian as the sum of onsite and lexicographically ordered bond terms, form the exact full-Hamiltonian exponential at horizon 1/3, and compare it with both onsite-first and reverse-term products for N in {3,6,12} and time signs -1,+1.

Propagate the right and left cubic multiplier orientations and their difference under the split and exact discrete adjoint histories at the same step size; check unitary, identity, finiteness and Gibbs four-leg errors row by row, with the fine-grid error no larger than the coarser declared grids.
Rebuild oscillator embeddings, split terms, spectral factors and histories independently, and compile Lean R331 for exact rational horizon/refinement and orientation-difference bookkeeping.
finding: Primary 221/221 and independent 221/221 assertions pass over 36 finite rows; the integrated verifier passes 15/15 and Lean R331 compiles. The maximum primary final-unitary errors decrease from 0.11789615563131273 at N=3 to 0.058756755061206756 at N=6 and 0.029354754101819213 at N=12. Maximum right/left/commutator history errors decrease from 0.011260464017179114 to 0.0068627271800160905 to 0.0037347781670976302, while maximum Gibbs history error decreases from 0.019690880828081722 to 0.012001607313485603 to 0.00653143372234928. Primary and independent derived maxima agree within 2e-16, and all declared split/exact identities and positive-energy checks pass.
decision_reason: The finite split-history carrier is now explicitly connected to the exact finite-Q3 Hamiltonian flow for both product orders and both time orientations, including the two noncommuting multiplier histories. This removes an unverified finite-model substitution from the QFT route. The observed coarse-to-fine decrease is not an analytic rate and does not establish a volume-, cutoff- or beta-uniform thermodynamic history.
boundary: Finite oscillator-dimension-three matrices on volumes 2, 4 and 6, source pair [0,1], one probe per volume, beta values 0.5, 1 and 2, finite horizon 1/3 and step counts 3, 6 and 12 only; no common operator domain, analytic Trotter estimate, thermodynamic Q3 history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, source/volume/beta uniformity, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion.
next_action: Replace the finite error trend with an analytic finite-volume Lie-Trotter rate on a specified common core, then combine it with a pairwise-union volume estimate for the two-orientation histories. If the constants grow with volume or the domain cannot be made common, record that exact route-local obstruction and keep common-alpha open.
no_overclaim: This audit validates only a finite split-to-exact-Q3 bridge and finite history convergence trend. It neither proves a thermodynamic QFT dynamics nor establishes common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, a mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
open: common operator domain and product/core density
source/volume/beta-uniform direct D and delta-D Cauchy
gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: The exact comparison exponential uses the same finite full Hamiltonian reconstructed from every onsite and bond term; no hidden parameter substitution is made.
Both split orders and both time signs are run, and each is compared with the corresponding exact sign of the same full Hamiltonian.
Right and left noncommuting cubic products and their difference are propagated separately under split and exact increments; no commutation is assumed.
The monotone coarse-to-fine test is a finite diagnostic with a declared tolerance; it is not an analytic rate or an infinite sequence proof.
Gibbs four-leg errors use the normalized full-Hamiltonian state at each declared beta and remain diagnostics, not beta-uniform bounds.
Finite split-to-exact agreement does not prove a common core, exhaustion-independent dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

qft_interface.closed: The finite split-history carrier is tied to the exact finite-Q3 Hamiltonian by two-order, two-sign Lie-Trotter comparisons and matching two-orientation history checks.
qft_interface.open: Analytic Trotter control, common domains, thermodynamic history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, source/volume/beta uniformity, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6 evidence only; no TECT production owner, heat_root_incidence, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.
